derivation: viewer at S; from the approved master (facing S) her RIGHT hand is on SCREEN-LEFT; turning her toward E brings her RIGHT side toward the camera, toward W her LEFT side

table.SW: she faces the viewer's LOWER-LEFT (turned 45° toward screen-left from the S pose). Her LEFT side is the side nearer the camera: the satchel on her LEFT hip hangs in FRONT, on the screen-right of her body, nearest the camera; her RIGHT arm and the staff are on the FAR side, on the screen-left of her body, partly behind her, the staff tip rising above her far shoulder. Her face is visible, looking toward the screen's lower-left.
table.W: full LEFT profile — she faces screen-left. The side toward the camera is her LEFT side: the satchel on her left hip is in FRONT, nearest the camera, at her hip; her RIGHT arm and the staff are on the FAR side, behind her body — the staff shaft mostly hidden behind her, its tip rising above her far shoulder and its foot showing beside her far boot. Face in left profile.
table.NW: she faces the viewer's UPPER-LEFT (a back-three-quarter view, turned 135° from the S pose). Her BACK and her LEFT side are visible; her LEFT side is nearer the camera: the satchel on her left hip is on the SCREEN-LEFT, nearest the camera; her RIGHT arm and the staff are on the FAR side, on the SCREEN-RIGHT, behind her, the staff tip above her far shoulder. Her head is turned AWAY toward the UPPER-LEFT — the face is NOT visible.
table.NE: she faces the viewer's UPPER-RIGHT (a back-three-quarter view, turned 135° the other way). Her BACK and her RIGHT side are visible; her RIGHT side is nearer the camera: her RIGHT arm and the staff are on the SCREEN-RIGHT, nearest the camera; the satchel on her left hip is on the FAR side, on the screen-left, mostly hidden behind her. Her head is turned AWAY toward the UPPER-RIGHT — the face is NOT visible.
table.E: full RIGHT profile — she faces screen-right. The side toward the camera is her RIGHT side: her RIGHT arm and the staff are in FRONT, nearest the camera, the staff upright beside her; the satchel on her left hip is on the FAR side, hidden behind her body. Face in right profile.
table.SE: she faces the viewer's LOWER-RIGHT (turned 45° toward screen-right from the S pose). Her RIGHT side is the side nearer the camera: her RIGHT arm and the staff are in FRONT, on the screen-left of her body, nearest the camera; the satchel on her LEFT hip is on the FAR side, on the screen-right of her body, partly behind her. Her face is visible, looking toward the screen's lower-right.
